item_id.description: Exact ID of the supplied fixed extracted item.

score.description:
Probability that this individual statement preserves its complete source
meaning and all governing conditions needed for independent use. This is
not confidence that every rule in the document was extracted. Missing
qualifiers, alternatives, required details or unresolved dependencies
reduce confidence even when the passage is clear and the quote is exact.

basis.description:
Brief externally checkable grounds or specific uncertainty for this score.
Describe source ambiguity or a dependency; do not give private reasoning
or a step-by-step account. One short basis is usually sufficient.
